description: As-of date = latest snapshot_date in the data; snapshot history is not used for trends (days are independent).
owner_question: Which date should we treat as 'today' for the stock position, and is the daily snapshot history meant to be continuous?

description: Plant of a stock row = plant_id on that row in the latest snapshot.
owner_question: The same material and warehouse appear under different plants on different days. Which plant does a warehouse belong to?

description: Usable = on_hand - allocated - blocked - quality_hold, floored at 0 (no overlap assumed between the deductions).
owner_question: Can the same unit be both allocated and blocked / on quality hold, or are the three deductions separate quantities?

description: inventory_status is ignored in calculations; the quantity columns decide.
owner_question: What does inventory_status mean when a row marked QUALITY_HOLD still has most of its quantity unrestricted?

description: Safety stock = dim_material.safety_stock_qty, applied per material x plant; the snapshot's value is ignored.
owner_question: Which safety stock is authoritative: the material master or the per-warehouse value in the snapshot?

description: All four warehouses count toward plant stock; the warehouse is a filter.
owner_question: Should stock in WIP-WH-01 and FG-WH-01 count as available component supply for production?

description: Snapshot in_transit_qty = internal transfers, arriving in_transit_days after as-of; not the same as open PO quantity.
owner_question: What is in_transit_qty (inbound PO goods or inter-plant transfers) and when does it arrive?

description: PO open qty = ordered - received for OPEN / PARTIAL; CLOSED = short-closed, nothing more due.
owner_question: Every CLOSED line received less than ordered. Is the remainder cancelled, or still due?

description: receipt_date <= as-of = actual receipt; a later receipt_date = expected receipt date. What arrives on that date depends on A19: by default only the open quantity (ordered - received) of OPEN / PARTIAL lines; the received_qty already recorded on future-dated lines is not counted.
owner_question: Some lines carry a receipt_date after the as-of date with a received_qty. Has that quantity arrived, or is it a planned receipt?

description: Overdue open PO lines are expected at as-of + that supplier's average delay (past receipts, receipt - promised, at least 1 day).
owner_question: For open lines past their promised date, is there a confirmed new delivery date?

description: Approved vendor = supplier whose material_category matches the material's. AUDIO and CONNECTOR have no matching supplier: proposals show 'supplier to be assigned'.
owner_question: Which suppliers are approved for each material, in particular AUDIO and CONNECTOR parts?

description: Price for proposal value = standard_price_inr; RFQ prices not used.
owner_question: Which price should a purchase proposal be valued at?

description: Expiry checked only where expiry_date exists (2 consumables).
owner_question: Do any other materials have shelf-life limits we should track?

description: Max stock is not in the data: max = SS + daily demand x (lead time + review period) x max_factor.
owner_question: Do you have a maximum stock level or days-of-cover limit per material?

description: No forward production plan exists (latest planned start 15-Oct). Demand comes from the planning scenario, labelled 'Planning scenario' in the UI.
owner_question: Can you share the forward production plan (MPS) for the next 60 days?

description: Customer orders don't link to production orders (0% ID match): display only, no customer impact.
owner_question: How do production orders link to customer orders?

description: Consumables (solder paste, adhesive) are not in the BOM: no demand basis, so they are excluded from shortage calculation and flagged.
owner_question: What is the consumption rate of solder paste and thermal adhesive per phone or per day?

description: Actual lead time = receipt_date - po_date on past receipts, per supplier x material.
owner_question: Is receipt_date the goods-receipt posting date at the plant?

description: Future-dated receipts: open_qty_only = only ordered - received of OPEN / PARTIAL lines is expected supply; full_received_qty = the received_qty on lines with receipt_date after as-of also arrives on that date.
owner_question: Lines dated after the as-of date carry a received_qty. Is that quantity already in stock, still to arrive, or not real?

description: Planning lead time for the supplier a proposal would pick (approved -> best on-time % -> shortest lead time): actual = that supplier's actual lead time (A18), master = dim_material.lead_time_days, max = the larger of the two.
owner_question: Should planning use the supplier's actual lead time, the master lead time, or the more cautious of the two?

description: Overdue production backlog (applies when demand_source = production_orders): open orders (RELEASED / IN_PROGRESS) planned on or before the as-of date are still owed and fall due on as-of + 1, for their full order_qty (hourly production cannot show what is already built). exclude = count only orders planned after as-of.
owner_question: All open production orders are dated before the data date. Are they still to be built (backlog), and should their full quantity count as demand?
